Nice brushes, but the colored paint on the handles gets all over your fingers when using acrylic monomer and acetone. The quality of the bristles are nice. I have had them for 6 months and they been used on many clients and demonstrations. I put a gel top coat at the portion where I hold the brushes. Shipped very quickly, packaged nice and it's very handy to have the pouch to keep them in. reviews.t: Work well for the first use, then get hard ...
reviews.x: Work well for the first use, then get hard with nail polish and you can't use them again. Not going to buy more. The paint on the handle also comes off and stains your fingers! What a mess that is trying to clean it up.
I received my set today and the Brush bristles are all hard and stuck together I can't even use them.I am so disappointed. I would not recommend this set.

They are as nice as opi and cnd brand ones I have. I don't normally use a pointed acrylic brush but they work great for sculpting and the gel brushes work amazing too. These are definitely worth buying.

It came quickly and are nice brushes... DO NOT USE WITH ASSATONE  I accidentally got a little on the handle and it started eating the paint off instantly. They do feel a little cheaply made but for the price they work for what there made for.
I really like these brushes, and the dotting tools. Lots of tutorials out there to give you ideas.

The set has held up well over several months with gentle washing by hand with liquid dish detergent, I use Dawn, and then air drying. I decided to buy these verses the others I looked at because I liked the way they were labeled and the variety of brushes. It was a nice surprise to get this kit and see that the dotting tool was double ended so you get four sizes! the other kit I got, not this brand, had only one size and was only five tools total. The clutch bag is super cute and very sparkly. The brushes come in 3 fun colors. You have everything you could ever need in this set.The other tools are made out of wood,  they are also very sturdy. The brushes themselves are light, thin and comfortable to use. They also don't feel cheap or like they'd break easily. The bristles in each of the brushes are soft, well attached to the brush stick and diverse. *I received this at a discounted price for my honest review

I received my Clyppi nail brushes today. The case the nail brushes come in is so pretty, a nice sparkly silver color. It comes with 10 various sized brushes and it two double ended silver ball things that give a neat design effect to your nails. The brushes are very light, soft, and easy to use and clean. Do not leave the brushes in the cleaning solution though (paint thinner, alcohol or water), I followed the directions on the package and they cleaned up nicely.

The brushes look nice, however, I tried to use one of the acrylic nail brushes to do my fill.  The bristles were stuck together but after I dipped and wiped them a few times, they became useable.  Unfortunately the brush did not work well and metal part disconnected from the wooden stick about 5 minutes in.  I have not used the nail art brushes yet, so I will not completely slam the set.

reviews.t: Nice brush set. Would probably not recommend to a friend
reviews.x: When I ordered I didn't realize that these were acrylic, and there for cannot be used in acetone. There's a nice variety of shapes, but some of them are just a little too soft. It is very difficult to properly clean with just thinner, and no acetone. The dotters really made this worth the price. Not too big of a fan of the case- seems bulky

Can't beat this little pack of brushes for the price. Two of the brushes were defective. I contacted the seller asking them to replace those 2 brushes. They responded immediately and shipped me an entire new kit. Thank you. I will buy from this seller again. I will buy more of these brushes when I need them, as well.

reviews.t: The sellers are great and really care about your satisfaction
reviews.x: The sellers are great and really care about your satisfaction. I haven't used all of the brushes yet, but the ones I have used work great. I used them to clean up the gel nail polish on the sides of my nails and the gel polish was easy to clean off the brush. No bristle fall out and the packaging is nice.

reviews.t: Overall a great product! Shipping was fast
reviews.x: Overall a great product! Shipping was fast. My only complaint is that glitter is falling off the case a little. I wish there was a plain black case option or a non-glitter case option. I'd still buy it again though since it's easy to put the brushes and dotters in another case.

I haven't had a chance to use these yet. But my 10yr old daughter has used them a few times on herself and is so excited with how easy they are to use that she is now inviting her friends over to do their nails. I look forward to using these on myself, this is a great product.

reviews.t: Good brushes at a good price
reviews.x: Recently started doing my own gel manicures at home to save money and needed to build up a supply of tools. I chose these brushes based on previous reviews and am pleased I did.  The sparkly case is adorable and my 3 year old wants to snag it for her princess dress up stuff!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the set as complete and offering a wide variety of brushes and dotting tools for nail art, gel, and acrylic work.
Many customers find the included carrying case sturdy, cute, and handy for storage.
Several reviewers report the colored paint on the handles comes off and stains fingers, especially with acetone or monomer.
Some buyers complain the bristles harden or arrive stuck together, making the brushes unusable after first use.
Multiple reviewers consider the set good quality and value for the price.
